```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = {
    "StichtagDat": ["2024-12-31", "2025-12-31", "2019-12-31", "2020-12-31", "2021-12-31"],
    "AlterV10Lang": ["30- bis 39-Jährige"] * 5,
    "SexLang": ["männlich"] * 5,
    "KreisLang": ["Kreis 7", "Kreis 7", "Kreis 10", "Kreis 10", "Kreis 10"],
    "AnzHunde": [1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Prepare the plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.barplot(x='StichtagDat', y='AnzHunde', hue='KreisLang', data=df)

# Customize the plot
plt.title('Number of Dogs by Date and District')
plt.xlabel('Date')
plt.ylabel('Number of Dogs')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend(title='District')

# Save the result
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.close()
```
